analysis: The code ensures that message is never null (set to empty string if null). The variable indexOfStart starts at 0 and is only incremented to positions that are within the bounds of the string (from indexOf results, it never exceeds message.length()). For substring(beginIndex), beginIndex is always between 0 and message.length() inclusive, so no IndexOutOfBoundsException. For substring(beginIndex, endIndex), endIndex is always at least beginIndex (from indexOf searching forward) and at most message.length(), so no IndexOutOfBoundsException. All calls are safe.
answer: IndexOutOfBoundsException: its throwing condition is avoided.
remark: All substring calls are made with indices that are guaranteed to be within valid range: beginIndex is always between 0 and message.length() inclusive, and endIndex (when used) is between beginIndex and message.length() inclusive. Therefore, no IndexOutOfBoundsException can occur.
